name: Ashley
source:
She met [url=/c100657]Gerald[/url] when whe was a burlesque dancer in Sunshine Bay. With her daughter [url=/c100643]Childhood Friend[/url] they moved and lived as a family with [url=/c100657]Gerald[/url] and [url=/c100642]Protagonist[/url]. After five years she broke up with him, moved back to Sunshine Bay and cut all ties with them. She got degrees in Archaeology and Psychology and owns two properties in Sunshine Bay. She was also the previous owner of the hotel, having handed its reins to her daughter.

[url=/c100653]Thrisha[/url] is her older sister and [url=/c100644]Cousin[/url] is her niece.
